habit.description: After blocking two hits in a row the Kappa grabs. Stop at one hit, or jump or back off after the second block, and the throw whiffs.

notes: Anti-air (YOK-165): answers opponent_jumping with the generic throw (C4), the single attacking answer so jump_punish_pct sets the rate; it catches the jumper in landing frames (E19). Swap to a Kappa rising normal when one lands. Kappa patient (Y2): blocks, then throws after two blocked hits (that throw is the habit above). Its throw is the generic throw (C4); data/moves has no kappa-* normals or clips yet, so it has no strikes of its own. Add pokes when they land. YOK-234: River Grab punishes recovery (weight 15 beside the generic throw 20); Shell Spin (projectile-invulnerable) on projectile_on_screen, weight 40, Elder Kappa only because the rare is in the elder loadout (A9); absent move is skipped. Habit (generic throw after two blocked hits) and tell_cover unchanged.
